result.title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
result.summary: Recent video generators produce realistic videos, yet controlling how scenes unfold remains challenging. Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order. However, these coarse inputs leave details unspecified and may contain artifacts that should not be reproduced. Successful proxy-guided generation must therefore Preserve intended structure, Complete missing content and correct proxy artifacts, and Bind text, image, and audio conditions to the right entities and events. We introduce ProxyGenBench to study these interacting requirements, with 312 evaluation cases from 60 scenes across three scene tasks and controlled variations in proxy fidelity, text detail, and multimodal inputs. We evaluate five video generators using verified, case-specific checklists. Experiments show that proxies improve spatiotemporal control, but greater proxy detail can coincide with poorer completion, while strong structural adherence does not ensure correct binding.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ProxyGenBench，用 3D blockout 等结构化代理引导视频生成，构建 312 个案例并在代理保真度、文本细节与多模态输入变化下考察「保留结构、补全缺失、绑定条件」三项要求。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「代理越细→补全可能变差」及「结构遵循≠条件与实体正确绑定」的分解，可能为 latent 状态中结构抽象与视觉细节保留、证据与实体绑定的评价设计提供参照，但属视频生成，与 VLM 推理状态的联系仍需核查。
